name: Administrative Committee Meeting - CHANGE OF DATE NOTICE - moving meeting from 6/8/26 to 6/9/26
agenda_text:
Meeting of the City Council's
  ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEE

  CHANGE IN DATE

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN the following REGULAR meeting scheduled for

  JUNE 8, 2026 AT 4:00 p.m.

  WILL NOW MEET ON

  JUNE 9, 2026 AT 4:00 p.m.

June 5, 2026

I, Antoinette M. Mann, declare as follows:

  That I am the City of Westlake Village City Clerk. The Regular Meeting for the
Administrative Committee (City Council Committee) scheduled for June 8, 2026 has been
moved to June 9, 2026 at 4:00 pm.
  I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct.

___________________________________
Antoinette M. Mann
City Clerk

Posted:  City Hall Public Notice Board, City Website
